meta.parties: Samsudeen v. Eagle Star Insurance Co. Ltd

rules.statement: Unless the plaintiff has failed to take a step rendered necessary by the law, an order of abatement should not be made under section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Both on principle and on authority it seems to us that unless the plaintiff has failed to take a step rendered necessary by the law, an order of abatement should not be made under section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code
